name: browser-youtube-play-all
description: Adds "Play All" buttons for Videos, Shorts, and Streams on YouTube, with sorting by Latest, Popular, or Oldest.

scripts.review:test: bun run build && xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args="-screen 0 1600x900x24" bunx playwright test tests/review/ --workers=1 --project=chrome-desktop-e2e --project=chrome-mobile-e2e
scripts.setup: bun i && wxt prepare && bunx playwright install chromium firefox
scripts.test: bun run build && xvfb-run --auto-servernum bunx playwright test tests/e2e tests/review
scripts.test-specs: bun run build && xvfb-run --auto-servernum bunx playwright test tests/specs
scripts.test-ui-mode: bun run build && bunx playwright test --ui
